title: Four-door birch ply wardrobe with lights
summary: A four-door wardrobe in birch ply, lit inside, with rails, shelves, drawers and hidden boxes under the floor panels.
intro: A fitted wardrobe filling a recess, built in birch ply with the layered edges left on show. Behind the four doors: hanging rails, shelves, a stack of three drawers and warm strip lights along the top. In two of the bays the floor panels lift out on finger holes to boxes underneath, for the things you do not need every week.

cover.alt: Four-door birch ply wardrobe filling a recess, with long wooden pull handles

model3d.text: The wardrobe drawn in SketchUp from the photos, at standard sizes rather than measured ones. Open the doors: the drawers slide out and the floor panels lift out of the two left bays to show the hidden boxes.
